features.dailyAttendanceDesc: Real-time attendance tracking for every class. Parents receive instant notifications when their child is marked absent.
features.homeworkDesc: Teachers post homework with deadlines. Students can submit work online. Parents stay informed about pending tasks.
features.marksResultsDesc: Complete academic records including weekly tests, monthly exams, and term results. Download printable result cards anytime.
features.announcementsDesc: Important notices, event updates, and school news delivered directly to students and parents through the portal.
features.communicationDesc: Direct messaging between parents and teachers. Stay connected about your child's progress and any concerns.
features.calendarDesc: View exam schedules, holidays, events, and important dates. Never miss a school activity or deadline.
